scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.validate: npm run audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.validate:web: cd frontend && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.db:test: npm run db:test:fresh && npm run db:test:upgrade
